title: This Giant Waterlily Species Was Discovered Via Instagram - Nautilus
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementEnvironmentThis Giant Waterlily Species Was Discovered Via InstagramThey can grow to more than 6 feet in diameterDNBy David Nield11:30 AM CDT on October 20, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleSay what you will about Instagram, but the social media platform has undeniably contributed to the furthering of scientific research. The latest case-in-point: A new species of giant waterlily has been discovered thanks to a selfie.The photo, taken by botanist Jeremiah Harris, featured a huge waterlily that Harris himself identified as Victoria amazonica. However, the location in which it was taken—along the Inírida River in Guainía, Colombia—piqued the interest of waterlily expert Carlos Magdalena, from the Royal Botanic Gardens in the U.K. The Inírida River is beyond the natural range of the V. amazonica species, which suggested to Magdalena that this was something new.Read more: “Plants Can Hear the Sound of Falling Rain”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
